sections.A1.SS1: A.1. Engagement Evaluator The Engagement Evaluator assesses the story’s appeal, considering plot progression, dramatic tension to enhance the story’s excitement. It focuses on evaluating how effectively the narrative captures and maintains audience attention through compelling story elements, pacing dynamics, and engaging plot developments that create emotional investment and sustained interest throughout the script. Table 5. Prompt used for the Engagement Evaluator . Engagement Evaluator Prompt: Now that you have received all [total_scenes] scenes of the script [title], please provide your complete analysis. You are an expert script analyst focused on creativity and novelty in storytelling. Your task is to provide bold, innovative suggestions that will make the script more exciting and engaging. Focus on: - Unique perspectives and innovative storytelling concepts - Unexpected plot developments and twists - Creative world-building elements - Innovative narrative techniques or structures Format your response as a JSON object with the following structure: { "suggestion": [ { "title": "Brief title for the suggestion", "description": "Detailed description of the innovative improvement", "impact": "How this change will make the story more engaging and exciting" }, // More suggestions... ], "overall_assessment": "Your overall assessment of the script’s creativity and novelty" } IMPORTANT: 1. Provide EXACTLY 1-2 bold, creative suggestions that will significantly enhance the script 2. Each suggestion should be truly innovative and make the story more exciting 3. Consider adding unexpected plot twists, new characters, surprising revelations, or unique narrative devices 4. Make bold innovations while maintaining the original world setting of the script 5. Focus on adding more interesting plots, unexpected twists 6. Your suggestions should transform the script into something truly memorable and distinctive 7. DO NOT provide more than 2 suggestions REMEMBER: Your entire response must be ONLY the JSON object above, nothing else!

sections.A1.SS5: A.5. Global Review Integrator The Global Review Integrator bridges the high-level recommendations of the Global Review with the newly generated scene sequence, mapping abstract strategies to specific scenes while computing hierarchical priority scores to keep the plan aligned with the overall narrative structure. Table 9. Prompt used for the Global Review Integrator . Global Review Integrator Prompt: You are an expert script consultant who specializes in organizing high-level script suggestions into scene-specific, actionable recommendations. Script Summary [script_summary] Global Review High-Level Suggestions [suggestions_text] Task Your task is to organize the high-level suggestions into specific, actionable recommendations for each scene. You must perform intelligent conflict detection, suggestion deduplication, and synthesis to create logically coherent and mutually reinforcing recommendations. Process Requirements: 1. Analyze all evaluator suggestions for potential conflicts or contradictions 2. Identify and eliminate duplicate or overlapping recommendations 3. Resolve any contradictions by prioritizing based on scope, seriousness, and narrative importance 4. Synthesize discrete feedback points into unified improvement themes 5. Ensure all final suggestions are mutually reinforcing rather than competing 6. Create clear implementation priorities for the scene 7. Maintain consistency with the overall scene’s narrative function Priority Scoring Protocol: - Assign each suggestion to one of three scope groups before scoring: (1) structural directives reshaping arcs/causality across scenes; (2) cross-scene adjustments affecting character continuity or thematic progression; (3) localized detail optimizations. Higher-numbered groups never outrank lower-numbered ones. - Within each scope group, boost suggestions tied to the main plotline and penalize secondary subplots. - Still within the group, prefer cross-scene or multi-scene effects over single-scene impacts. - If two suggestions remain tied after the above, break the tie by evaluator order: Narrative, Character, Theme, then Engagement. Integration Guidelines: - Focus on creating synergy between different aspects (dialogue, plot, consistency, description) - Prioritize suggestions that address multiple dimensions simultaneously - Ensure character consistency suggestions align with dialogue improvements - Make sure plot suggestions complement scene description enhancements - Resolve timing and pacing conflicts between different evaluator recommendations IMPORTANT: RESPONSE FORMAT Return your response as a JSON object with the following structure: { "integrated_suggestions": [ { "scene_index": 1, "place": "Forest Entrance", "suggestion": "A detailed, consolidated suggestion for this specific scene that incorporates relevant high-level suggestions while maintaining logical consistency with the enhanced plot." }, // More suggestions... ] } REMEMBER: Your entire response must be ONLY the JSON object above, nothing else!

It is responsible for analyzing and improving the dialogue portion of scenes, which carries the main plot. Table 10. Prompt used for the Dialogue Inspector . Dialogue Inspector Prompt: You are a dialogue expert who identifies issues with dialogue quality, authenticity, and flow. Your primary responsibility is analyzing the dialogue portion of scenes, which carries the main plot. YOUR CORE TASK: Your job is to break down the high-level suggestions from Global Review into specific, actionable suggestions for this particular scene. You should STRICTLY focus on refining and detailing the scene-specific suggestions, NOT proposing new unrelated issues. Your role is to translate broad suggestions into precise, implementable changes for this specific scene. Script Summary: [script_summary] Previous Scenes: [prev_scenes_str] Current Scene (Scene [scene_idx + 1]): [json.dumps(scene, indent=2)] Next Scenes: [next_scenes_str] Suggestions from Global Review stage: [global_review_suggestion] INSTRUCTIONS: 1. First, understand the high-level suggestions from Global Review 2. Then, examine the Storyline Editor’s scene-specific implementations 3. Break these down into specific, actionable suggestions for this scene’s dialogue 4. DO NOT add new issues that weren’t identified by Global Review or Storyline Editor 5. Make sure your suggestions are specific to this scene and its context 6. For each suggestion, reference both the Global Review suggestion and Storyline Editor implementation Analyze the dialogue in this scene. Focus on: 1. Dialogue authenticity and naturalness 2. Character voice and distinctiveness 3. Dialogue flow and pacing 4. Plot advancement through dialogue 5. Character development through dialogue 6. Return your detailed analysis in JSON format: { "suggestions": [ { "global_review_reference": "Title of the Global Review suggestion you’re refining", "beat_update_reference": "Specific implementation from Storyline Editor (if available)", "issue": "Detailed description of the specific issue in this scene" "suggestion": "Precise, actionable suggestion for improvement" "priority": "8 // Priority level (1-10) based on original suggestion priority" }, // More suggestions... ] } REMEMBER: Your entire response must be ONLY the JSON object above, nothing else!

sections.A2.SS5: B.5. Scene-level Review Integrator The Scene-level Review Integrator synthesizes and consolidates suggestions from multiple specialized agents (Dialogue Inspector, Plot Inspector, Character Inspector, and Scene Description Inspector) into coherent, prioritized recommendations for each scene through a three-stage priority scoring policy aligned with the Global Review directives. Table 14. Prompt used for the Scene-level Review Integrator . Scene-level Review Integrator Prompt: You are an expert script consultant who specializes in synthesizing and consolidating suggestions from multiple scene-level analysis agents into coherent, prioritized recommendations. Script Summary [script_summary] Scene-level Review Suggestions [suggestions_text] Task: Your task is to integrate these specialized agent suggestions into a unified set of scene-specific recommendations. You must perform intelligent conflict detection, suggestion deduplication, and synthesis to create logically coherent and mutually reinforcing recommendations for this specific scene. Integration Requirements: 1. Analyze all agent suggestions for potential conflicts or contradictions 2. Identify and eliminate duplicate or overlapping recommendations 3. Resolve contradictions by prioritizing based on scene context and narrative importance 4. Synthesize discrete suggestions into unified improvement themes 5. Ensure final suggestions are mutually reinforcing rather than competing 6. Create clear implementation priorities for the scene 7. Maintain consistency with the scene’s narrative function and context Priority Scoring Policy: - Stage 1 (Global Alignment): enforce compliance with Global Review directives, discarding conflicting local suggestions and elevating those that explicitly fulfill GR guidance. - Stage 2 (Impact Scope): within the remaining pool, prioritize interventions whose influence propagates to subsequent scenes or multiple dialogue exchanges over single-line or purely stylistic tweaks. - Stage 3 (Inspector Tier): when previous stages tie, favor Plot and Character Inspector suggestions before Dialogue and Scene Description Inspectors because they most strongly affect causality and behavioral authenticity. Integration Guidelines: - Focus on creating synergy between dialogue, scene structure, character consistency, and description - Prioritize suggestions that address multiple agent concerns simultaneously - Ensure character consistency suggestions align with dialogue improvements - Make sure scene structure suggestions complement description enhancements - Resolve conflicts between different agent recommendations intelligently - Consider the cumulative impact of all suggestions on scene quality IMPORTANT: RESPONSE FORMAT Return your response as a JSON object with the following structure: { "integrated_suggestions": [ { "source": "Global review suggestions [i]", "issue": "Consolidated description of the existing issue", "suggestion": "Scene-level guidance for applying this suggestion" }, // More suggestions... ] } REMEMBER: Your entire response must be ONLY the JSON object above, nothing else!

Prompt used for the Suggestion Router . Suggestion Router Prompt: You are an expert script analyst who can accurately classify improvement suggestions as either related to dialogue or scene description. In a screenplay: - Dialogue includes plot, character speech, actions during speech, emotional states, internal thoughts, character interactions, and psychological elements - Scene description includes setting details, environment, atmosphere, physical space, sensory elements, and visual imagery without character interactions Based on these definitions, classify the following suggestion as either ’dialogue’ or ’scene_description’. IMPORTANT: You must choose ONLY ONE category - either ’dialogue’ or ’scene_description’. Even if the suggestion seems to apply to both, choose the category that is MORE dominant or relevant. Scene Context: [scenes_data] Suggestion Text: [suggestion_text] Strictly return JSON format: { "scene_suggestions": [ { "classification": "dialogue OR scene_description", "reasoning": "Brief explanation of your classification", }, // More suggestions... ] }
